tonight_boundary: Preparation only. No production construction, migration, deployment, or irreversible implementation is authorized by this contract. Per the council-approved delegation ruling (2026-08-12), a delegated session commits and pushes its own completed explicit-path work on an isolated branch as evidence packaging; merge to the protected trunk, deployment, production writes, and external communication remain separately authorized.

rules: reconcile against current integration baseline before release verification
